Package game.pestcontrol

Class DeterrentItem

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.items.Item
game.pestcontrol.DeterrentItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, PestDeterrent
Direct Known Subclasses:
LadybugJar, PestTrap, SaltBarrier
public abstract class DeterrentItem extends Item implements PestDeterrent
An item the Farmer carries and uses once to defend the farm against pests.

While carried, it offers a DeployDeterrentAction. A subclass only says what using it does (PestDeterrent.deterAround(edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Location, edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.GameMap)) and, if it needs to, where it can be used (canDeployAt(edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Location)).
